title: Real movement features from GeoLife GPS trajectories, at this app's ping rate
citation: Zheng, Xie, Ma. GeoLife: A Collaborative Social Networking Service among User, Location and Trajectory. IEEE Data Eng. Bull. 33(2), 2010.

method.ping_gating: >= 15 s and >= 25 m, or a 120 s heartbeat (as hooks/useGeolocation.js)
method.planned_stops: trip start, trip end, stay points (<= 200 m for >= 10 min)

caveats: Recorded mostly in Beijing, 2007-2012 -- walking, cycling, bus, car, metro and train behaviour transfers, but it is not Indian tourist data.
Speed is distance/time between pings, not the phone's instantaneous GPS speed.
Contains only normal movement: real labelled emergencies (abduction, collapse) do not exist in any public dataset, so evaluation anomalies remain simulated.
